name: Chēng T’ien
bio: Chēng T’ien’s dates are printed as 656–698 in the Chronology of the Poets in Bynner’s The Jade Mountain.
The poems here are Witter Bynner’s versions, from the texts of Kiang Kang-hu, in The Jade Mountain (1929).

poems.title: On Ma-wei Slope
poems.author: Chēng T’ien
poems.translator: trans. Witter Bynner and Kiang Kang-hu (1929)
poems.text:
When the Emperor came back from his ride, they had murdered Lady Yang—
That passion unforgettable through all the suns and moons.
They had led him to forsake her by reminding him
Of an emperor slain with his lady once, in a well at Ching-yang Palace.
